name: Yanger
what_it_is: Yanger is an extensible YANG module validator written in Erlang that parses and validates YANG data models. It supports format conversion (tree, swagger, YIN, YANG) and transformations (expand, restconf) via a plugin architecture.
components: yanger.erl — main entry point and CLI driver
yang.erl — core YANG parser and type system
yang_xpath.erl — XPath evaluation for YANG constraints
plugins/ — output-format and transform plugins (swagger, tree, yin, yang, restconf, smiv2, sn, structure, expand, depend)
protocols: YANG (RFC 7950) — primary data modeling language parsed and validated
RESTCONF (RFC 8040) — restconf plugin generates RESTCONF-compatible output
Swagger/OpenAPI 2.0 — swagger plugin converts YANG to Swagger JSON
YIN — XML-based alternate YANG syntax (input and output)
SMIv2 — SNMP SMIv2 module support via yanger_smiv2 plugin
measurement: Validation error count and error codes (--print-error-code flag)
No built-in metrics export; output is textual error/warning messages
configuration: -f <format> — output format: tree, swagger, yin, yang, depend (default: none)
-t <transform> — transform to apply: expand, restconf, structure
--max-status <max_status> — filter nodes by YANG status (current, deprecated, obsolete)
-o <outfile> — write output to file instead of stdout
YANG_MODPATH env var — colon-separated module search path (set in Docker image)
fault_injection: No built-in fault injection; validation itself surfaces YANG schema errors
Invalid YANG syntax causes parse errors reported with line numbers and error codes
modes: Validation-only mode (default, no -f): parses and validates, reports errors/warnings
Format conversion mode (-f <format>): outputs tree, swagger JSON, YIN XML, or canonical YANG
Transform mode (-t <transform>): applies expand or restconf transforms before output
Verbose mode (-V): prints detailed processing information
Strict mode (--strict): enforces stricter YANG compliance rules
Docker container mode: single-binary ENTRYPOINT with /workdir volume mount
constraints: Requires Erlang runtime and libxml2 at runtime; no pure-binary distribution
Docker image based on erlang:23-alpine; YANG_MODPATH must include bundled modules directory or module resolution fails
Plugin discovery requires plugins to be on the Erlang code path or specified via -P; no hot-reload
Output format and transform combinations are not all valid; e.g., restconf transform requires subsequent format plugin
Feature flags (-F) use module:feature syntax; unknown features cause warnings unless --ignore-unknown-features is set
Max line length of 80 chars enforced in codebase; no tabs — contributors must follow this for patches to be accepted
docker_services: Single container: mbj4668/yanger — built from official erlang:23-alpine base, ENTRYPOINT yanger, WORKDIR /workdir, user mounts YANG files via -v ${PWD}:/workdir
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml — single standalone container only, no multi-service orchestration
No NETCONF protocol support despite YANG being NETCONF's schema language
No JSON/XML instance data validation — validates schema only, not instance documents
No REST API or daemon mode — purely a CLI batch tool
No YANG 1.1 (RFC 7950) full feature parity documented; primary target appears to be YANG 1.0 (RFC 6020)
No pre-built binary releases — must build from source or use Docker
